channel.title: The Measured Life — averagejoematt
channel.description: The weekly chronicle of an ordinary life, measured in full — every number, every week, including the weeks it dips. Written by Elena Voss.

item.title: The Org Chart of One Human and N Agents
item.description: At 07:45 every morning, an AI agent wakes up, reads my infrastructure's overnight alarms, diagnoses what broke, and — for a narrow class of provably-safe problems — fixes it and merges the fix before I've had coffee. The interesting part is not the agent. The interesting part is the sentence at the top of the merge gate's source file.
